limits: Static anatomical triangle calibration, not a full arm-IK or floor proof.
The actual point is blended Hand/ForeArm skin and must be sampled as the full skinned barycentric triangle after IK.
Near/far point differences must be carried/verified against the unchanged3mm physical contact gate during LOD transitions.
method: All16 actual native32 GLBs decoded with Draco;32 V3 calibrations independently checked by plane/ray intersection and3D Gram barycentric reconstruction. Exact paired model/motion SHA bindings and bounded proximal heel-pad domain are checked, as are actual triangle/material/bind vertices/named weights/frontmost hit. The maximin optimizer objective is recorded provenance, not an acceptance oracle. Runtime mixed-skin contact/fixedXZ acceptance remains separate.
